title: List sort picker offers hidden system fields: 队列 and an untranslated "Search Index" appear beside the business fields
body:
epic:#26676#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_cdb7a717def74e719988f089fbaa18ff

The maintainer: 「缺陷 2-7 立卡」 (2026-11-04).

Filed by the record-page epic seat from a browser evaluation of the Console on `main` `63b86b385d` (example CRM, zh-CN, dev admin). An independent reviewer ran the pass and the seat re-checked the evidence named below. No `domain:*` label is set: triage routes this card.

## Business reason

A rep sorting a list picks from a menu that includes 队列 and "Search Index". Neither means anything to them, and the second is English on a Chinese screen. Sorting by the search index returns an order nobody can explain, with no hint why.

## Reproduce

Open 线索 → 排序 → 添加排序 → open 排序依据. Measured by the seat on `/apps/com.example.crm/crm_lead`: 创建时间, 更新时间, 队列, 线索名称, 邮箱, 电话, 公司, 职位, 状态, 来源, 线索评分, 备注, Search Index. The filter panel's field list on 商机 showed neither.

## Code readings on `63b86b385d`

- `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx:5077-5099`: `filterFields` drops a field declared `hidden`, keeping it only when a held condition names it.
- `:5182-5217`: `sortFields` walks the same `candidateFields` and has no hidden check.
- `packages/spec/src/data/injected-system-column-provenance.ts:178-183` and `packages/objectql/src/search-companion.ts:316-320`: `queue` and `__search` are both `hidden: true`.

So this is one list that missed the rule its neighbour follows.

## Acceptance

1. The sort picker leaves out a field declared `hidden`, unless the current sort already names it. That row stays visible and removable, as today's `inUse` path does for other fields.
2. The hide-fields, group and row-color lists are read for the same gap, and any that share it are fixed here, with the list of what was read in the PR.
3. A test pins the sort picker.

## To check while here

The reviewer also reported `__search` in Studio's formula 插入字段 and in the validation 参与字段 list. On its screenshots the seat could confirm only 队列 in 插入字段. Measure these, and fix them here if real. A hidden field a formula may legitimately read needs the implementer's judgement, so report it rather than removing it silently.

## Re-check

`git grep -n "sortPicksRelationalField" origin/main -- ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx`
